buyback(address,uint256).details: The size cap is the guard's, the cooldown is the guard's, and the      module is one the owner registered. `minAmountOut` is the keeper's,      because the protocol token has no price feed to check it against —      see the note on BuybackModule.buyback. That is why the size cap      exists and why it should be set conservatively.

collectFees(address,address,uint256).details: Separate from the buyback itself so a redemption that the vault      refuses to price does not also block spending stable already on      hand, and so each half gets its own cooldown slot.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

pause().details: A sentinel can stop automation but cannot start it or run it. The      asymmetry is deliberate: halting is safe to hand out widely,      resuming is not.

rebalance(address,address).details: The keeper names the constituent. It does not choose the direction      or the size: the vault computes both from the live gap to target      and this caps them. Slippage is the guard's parameter, not the      keeper's, so a compromised keeper cannot accept a worse fill.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

buyback(address,uint256).notice: Spend fee revenue on the protocol token and retire it.

collectFees(address,address,uint256).notice: Turn a module's collected fee shares into stable.

cooldown().notice: Minimum seconds between actions on the same vault.

deployIdle(address).notice: Move a vault's idle balance into its lending venue, within limits.

isBuyback(address).notice: Buyback modules this guard is allowed to drive.

isSentinel(address).notice: Addresses that may halt automation without being able to run it.

isVault(address).notice: Vaults this guard is allowed to drive.

maxBuybackPerCall().notice: Largest amount of fee revenue a single buyback may spend.

maxDeployPerCall().notice: Largest amount a single call may allocate.

maxRebalancePerCall().notice: Largest amount a single rebalance may move between the legs.

maxSlippageBps().notice: Worst fill a rebalance may accept against the oracle price.

paused().notice: When true, every automated action reverts. Owner or sentinel.

rebalance(address,address).notice: Move a vault back toward its target split, within limits.
